localIssues: Weather seals need even contact along the opening. We inspect the retainer, panel alignment, and floor contact before deciding whether a seal replacement will address the gap.
localAdvice: Tell us whether the issue is drafts, water, visible light, or difficulty moving the door. Each symptom helps distinguish a fit problem from a moving-part repair.
